title: TeamFlowRL: Online Policy Optimization of Decentralized Flow Policies for Multi-Agent Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2611.32645v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Complex cooperative tasks require coordinated multi-agent behavior. Offline generative policies learn expressive cooperative behaviors from trajectories but remain limited by fixed datasets. Online reinforcement learning can improve them through environment interaction. However, fine-tuning flow policies is difficult because action likelihoods are hard to compute. We propose TeamFlowRL, a two-stage framework that pretrains multi-agent flow policies offline and fine-tunes them online. We formulate team policy optimization over the complete denoising trajectories of decentralized flow policies, avoiding intractable action likelihoods. The resulting objective weights each agent's trajectory ratio with a shared team advantage and clips each ratio separately, aligning local policy updates with the common team return. translated_title: TeamFlowRL：面向多智能体协作的去中心化流策略在线策略优化
translated_abstract: 复杂的协作任务需要协调一致的多智能体行为。离线生成式策略能够从轨迹中学习富有表现力的协作行为，但受限于固定的数据集；在线强化学习则可以通过与环境交互来改进这些策略。然而，由于动作似然难以计算，流策略的微调十分困难。我们提出了TeamFlowRL，这是一个两阶段框架，先离线预训练多智能体流策略，再对其进行在线微调。我们将团队策略优化建模在去中心化流策略的完整去噪轨迹之上，从而避免了难以处理的动作似然计算。所得的目标函数使用共享的团队优势对每个智能体的轨迹比率进行加权，并分别对每个比率进行裁剪，使局部策略更新与共同的团队回报保持一致。在七个仿真组的51个配对配置中，TeamFlowRL改进了所有离线初始化策略，平均提升47.3%（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: TeamFlowRL提出了一种两阶段框架，通过在去中心化流策略的完整去噪轨迹上构建团队策略优化目标（避免难以计算的动作似然），实现多智能体流策略的离线预训练与在线微调，在51个配对配置中平均提升47.3%。
